notes: Validation suite for 13 core enhancements plus multimodal vision support, scoped to enhancement-test-project.

tickets.title: Runtime logs show unhandled JSON parse failure in order creation
tickets.description: Use runtime logs under traces to identify the root source file and patch error handling so malformed request bodies return a clean 400 response instead of crashing.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime stack trace is mapped to concrete source location
Malformed JSON requests are handled without process crash
A deterministic error response is returned

tickets.title: Cross-system trace shows wrong downstream notification endpoint
tickets.description: Trace service-to-service calls and fix endpoint wiring so order confirmation targets the configured notification service URL across startup and runtime paths.
acceptance_criteria: Cross-service endpoint usage is discovered from code and configuration
Notification service URL is consistent across runtime path
No hardcoded conflicting URL remains

tickets.title: Incorrect tax output requires causal chain root-cause fix
tickets.description: A symptom appears as wrong final order totals. Resolve by identifying root cause across calculation and model handling rather than patching output formatting only.
acceptance_criteria: Fix addresses root cause, not only symptom
Order total and tax fields are consistent
Tests covering corrected flow pass

tickets.title: Primary fix path fails; switch strategy to configuration remediation
tickets.description: If direct code edit cannot pass validation, pivot to a config-first remediation that satisfies the same requirement without retrying the same failed edit pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Execution shows strategy pivot after failed path
Final solution is implemented through valid alternate files
No repeated identical failed patch attempts

tickets.title: Windows startup script fails on path and shell semantics
tickets.description: Make startup behavior platform-aware for Windows PowerShell by fixing script assumptions and path handling differences from bash-like environments.
acceptance_criteria: PowerShell script runs without shell syntax errors on Windows
Path separators and env var usage are Windows-safe
Service startup command succeeds

tickets.title: Workspace index misses repository root compose and nested compose relationship
tickets.description: Ensure indexing and retrieval capture both docker-compose files (root and src) and their relationship so planning uses correct deployment context.
acceptance_criteria: Both compose files are discoverable with grounded evidence
Planner can distinguish root vs src deployment role
No false missing-file classification for root compose

tickets.title: Build passes but runtime fails; feed verifier output into correction loop
tickets.description: After initial patch, runtime behavior still fails. Use runtime verification feedback to re-plan and apply a second corrective patch.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime verifier output is captured and used
A follow-up corrective patch is generated
Final runtime check passes

tickets.title: Use attached screenshot to infer broken UI-state expectation in API payload
tickets.description: A screenshot indicates a mismatched UI status label. Use visual evidence to update backend payload field mapping so returned status matches expected UI state.
acceptance_criteria: Visual signal is incorporated into ticket reasoning
Status mapping in API response is corrected
No unrelated schema fields are changed

tickets.title: Regression introduced by recent commit in order validation flow
tickets.description: Use git history and blame context to identify a recent regression in order validation and restore expected behavior with minimal file touch.
acceptance_criteria: Regression point is identified from git history
Fix is applied in the true owner file
Behavior matches pre-regression expectation

tickets.title: Service health probe fails for exposed endpoint contract
tickets.description: Use live probing to validate service endpoint and fix mismatched route behavior so health and orders endpoints return expected status codes.
acceptance_criteria: HTTP probe identifies failing endpoint contract
Endpoint behavior is corrected
Probe passes post-fix

tickets.title: TAX_RATE mismatch between env files and runtime use
tickets.description: Trace TAX_RATE propagation across .env, docker-compose, startup scripts, and runtime code, then align the source-of-truth value usage.
acceptance_criteria: All TAX_RATE definitions are traced
Runtime value source is consistent and intentional
Compose/script/env references are aligned

tickets.title: Missing dependency causes ModuleNotFoundError at startup
tickets.description: Resolve missing runtime dependency by identifying correct package mapping and updating dependency manifest used by this project.
acceptance_criteria: Missing module is mapped to correct package
Dependency manifest is updated
Startup no longer fails with ModuleNotFoundError

tickets.title: Align tax rate configuration between docker-compose and settings.json
tickets.description: docker-compose.yml sets the app service environment variable TAX_RATE=0.10, but config/settings.json has no matching tax_rate field, causing configuration drift between the container and the application settings. Add a top-level numeric field "tax_rate": 0.10 to config/settings.json, and keep docker-compose.yml's TAX_RATE=0.10 so both sources agree. Edit only these two configuration files directly — do NOT create any new Python module or validation framework. Both files must remain syntactically valid after the edit.
acceptance_criteria: config/settings.json contains a numeric top-level tax_rate field equal to 0.10
docker-compose.yml app service still sets TAX_RATE=0.10
Both YAML and JSON remain syntactically valid after the edit
No new Python validator module or wrapper file is created

tickets.title: Multimodal ticket with architecture diagram requires index alignment
tickets.description: Using attached architecture diagram, align service naming and index mapping so discovered components match visual flow labels used in tickets.
acceptance_criteria: Visual architecture labels are reflected in project config/index metadata
Discovery uses aligned service names
No unrelated runtime logic changes

tickets.title: Refactor discount threshold in calculation logic without removing existing models or deleting schemas
tickets.description: Update the discount calculation in src/models.py to apply a 15% discount for orders over $100. Do NOT delete or remove src/models.py, and do NOT drop or delete any existing schema fields or database configurations. Keep all other class definitions intact and edit only the discount helper function directly.
acceptance_criteria: src/models.py is modified, NOT deleted or removed
Discount calculation applies 15% discount for orders over $100
All existing models and schemas remain fully intact without deletion

tickets.title: Remove deprecated notification feature flag from config and clean up obsolete ContractMember model
tickets.description: Remove the deprecated "enable_notifications" field from the features object in config/settings.json. In src/models.py, delete the obsolete ContractMember class definition while keeping ProjectMember, CustomerModel, and OrderModel intact. Ensure config/settings.json remains syntactically valid JSON after the removal.
acceptance_criteria: config/settings.json no longer contains enable_notifications under features
src/models.py no longer contains the ContractMember class
ProjectMember, CustomerModel, and OrderModel remain fully functional and intact
config/settings.json remains syntactically valid JSON
